body: # Summary What I have been debugging ```Py import torch from torch.nn.attention.flex_attention import flex_attention, create_block_mask from torch._inductor import config as inductor_config def _enable_debug_settings() -> None: return # Match the debugging setup used to catch the cudagraph pool mismatch. inductor_config.triton.cudagraph_trees_history_recording = True inductor_config.triton.slow_path_cudagraph_asserts = True # Record allocator history so offending allocations include stack traces. try: torch.cuda.memory._record_memory_history() except TypeError: torch.cuda.memory._record_memory_history() @torch.no_grad() def test_flex_attention_cudagraph(): """Test flex attention with FLASH backend and CUDA graphs.""" if not torch.cuda.is_available(): print("CUDA not available, skipping test") return torch.manual_seed(42) device = torch.device("cuda") # Small dimensions for quick repro B, H, S, D = 2, 4, 128, 64 # Create inputs q = torch.randn(B, H, S, D, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16) k = torch.randn(B, H, S, D, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16) v = torch.randn(B, H, S, D, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16) # Create mask # block_mask = create_simple_mask(B, H, S, S, device) def attention_fn(q, k, v): return flex_attention( q, k, v, block_mask=None, kernel_options={"BACKEND": "FLASH"}, # Force CuteDSL/FLASH backend ) # Compile with max-autotune (enables CUDA graphs) compiled_fn = torch.compile( attention_fn, mode="max-autotune", fullgraph=True, ) print("Running warmup...") # Warmup for _ in range(3): out = compiled_fn(q, k, v) torch.cuda.synchronize() print("Running benchmark iterations...") # Run a few iterations for i in range(5): out = compiled_fn(q, k, v) torch.cuda.synchronize() print(f"Iteration {i+1}: output shape = {out.shape}") print("Test passed!") @torch.no_grad() def test_flex_attention_cudagraph_with_linear(): """Test flex attention with surrounding linear layers (more realistic).""" if not torch.cuda.is_available(): print("CUDA not available, skipping test") return torch.manual_seed(42) device = torch.device("cuda") # Dimensions B, H, S, D = 2, 4, 128, 64 hidden_dim = H * D # Create a simple attention block class AttentionBlock(torch.nn.Module): def __init__(self): super().__init__() self.qkv_proj = torch.nn.Linear(hidden_dim, 3 * hidden_dim, bias=False) self.out_proj = torch.nn.Linear(hidden_dim, hidden_dim, bias=False) def forward(self, x, block_mask): B, S, _ = x.shape qkv = self.qkv_proj(x) q, k, v = qkv.chunk(3, dim=-1) # Reshape for attention q = q.view(B, S, H, D).transpose(1, 2) k = k.view(B, S, H, D).transpose(1, 2) v = v.view(B, S, H, D).transpose(1, 2) # Flex attention with FLASH backend out = flex_attention( q, k, v, block_mask=block_mask, kernel_options={"BACKEND": "FLASH"}, ) # Reshape back out = out.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(B, S, hidden_dim) return self.out_proj(out) model = AttentionBlock().to(device).to(torch.bfloat16) x = torch.randn(B, S, hidden_dim, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16) # Compile compiled_model = torch.compile( model, mode="max-autotune", fullgraph=True, ) print("Running warmup...") for _ in range(3): out = compiled_model(x, None) torch.cuda.synchronize() print("Running benchmark iterations...") for i in range(5): out = compiled_model(x, None) torch.cuda.synchronize() print(f"Iteration {i+1}: output shape = {out.shape}") print("Test passed!") if __name__ == "__main__": import sys # Clear inductor cache import shutil import os cache_dir = f"/var/tmp/torchinductor_{os.environ.get('USER', 'unknown')}" if os.path.exists(cache_dir): print(f"Clearing inductor cache: {cache_dir}") shutil.rmtree(cache_dir) # Enable cudagraph + allocator history debugging _enable_debug_settings() print("=" * 60) print("Test 1: Simple flex attention with CUDA graphs") print("=" * 60) test_flex_attention_cudagraph() # print() # print("=" * 60) # print("Test 2: Flex attention with linear layers") # print("=" * 60) # test_flex_attention_cudagraph_with_linear() ``` the erroring output: ``` ❯ python flex/flash_cudagraphs.py ============================================================ Test 1: Simple flex RuntimeError(msg) RuntimeError: These live storage data ptrs are in the cudagraph pool but not accounted for as an output of cudagraph trees: Data Pointer: 140697262882816, history: ``` * Warmup (no cuda graph capture): runs fine. * Second run with cuda graph capture: hits cudagraph pool check complaining about a live storage (buf7) not accounted for. * Instrumentation added to the generated kernel (debug_owners) showed: no Python referrers to the storage; tensor referrers only appear from capture-time tuples/dicts/closure cells; storage referrers stay empty. * Disabling the kernel or returning before the _flash_attn_fwd.compile_cache[...] = cute.compile(...) line makes the issue disappear. * Bisect showed in image shows that on second run during graph capture + replay of the cached in global kernel we end up not deallocating the tensor storage for the LSE tensor. This is not an output because it gets DCEd when we are not doing bwds and this output is not needed cc @ptrblck @msaroufim @eqy @jerryzh168 @tinglvv @nWEIdia @mcarilli @ezyang @eellison @penguinwu @BoyuanFeng
